about: Personal facts said in conversation to one persona, questions to another persona (so the answer must come from knowledge, not from the conversation), changes of three kinds (fix, update, retract), and checks of what the store holds. Synthetic data. Do not change a frozen version; make a new one. v1 asked the questions in the same conversation, and the persona answered from the conversation. v3: a03 uses none_unless, so that a correct abstain that names the sister Dana (Tucson) passes.

Maple Street Dental takes bookings through Zocdoc.
My vet is Dr. Okafor at Birch Lane Animal Clinic. They book through PetDesk.
My family calendar is in the household Nextcloud.
The kids sports calendar and the chores calendar are in Nextcloud too.
My work calendar is in the company Google Workspace.
My sister Dana lives in Tucson.
I work at Brightline Logistics as an operations manager.
Our router is a Ubiquiti Dream Machine in the basement closet.
